entries.label: R-C2 household mirror seed 101 v3 (screened rigid household asset)
entries.public_goal: Match the reflection in the red outline in the initial head-camera view to its real apple among the widely spaced candidates. Grasp, lift and deliver that apple to the blue pad.

public.objective: Match the reflection in the red outline in the initial head-camera view to its real apple among the widely spaced candidates. Grasp, lift and deliver that apple to the blue pad.
public.success_criteria: Use a genuine robot grasp to lift each required apple at least 5 cm. Leave all required apples supported and released without robot contact for at least 0.5 seconds, with linear speed at most 0.02 m/s and angular speed at most 0.1 rad/s. Leave the working hand empty and open, withdraw the robot hands from the apples, and declare DONE.
public.environment: A furnished meeting room with apples on a fixed deck over an existing native table, a physical mirror, a red rectangular outline, blue and yellow delivery pads, and a fixed yellow reference pillar.
constraints: Keep the table, pads, mirror, red outline and yellow reference pillar fixed; preserve all object dimensions.
Use the existing guarded public controls and robot-mounted observations.
Interpret the requested appearance using the initial head-camera view. Later robot movement does not redefine the requested real apple.
The first candidate grasp commits the real-object selection. Do not grasp a different candidate.
Keep each unselected apple within 2 cm of its starting position.

geometry_proposal.scope: Saved static collision bounds, bounding-center height and approximate head eye; actual native collision centroid, projection, support and optics must qualify.

revision_evidence.assets: Static USD inspection finds cola_bottle/oyqdtz and marjoram_shaker/xlspnl have multiple enabled collision links (labels/glass). The current rigid household measurement intentionally supports one collision body. Use apple/agveuv and salt_shaker/fonexa, whose enabled geometry belongs to base_link.
revision_evidence.geometry: Recompute cue placement from the explicit replacement asset bounds; native measured collision centroids and optics must still qualify.
revision_evidence.invariants: Keep scenes, native furniture, object counts, slot permutations, seeds, operation rules and scoring. R-A1/R-A2 remain matched apart from their direct/reflected cue placement. No mesh or physical rule is removed.
revision_evidence.scope: Static asset screening is not native visibility or physical success evidence.
